items.title: 研究人員揭露竊取加密貨幣的ClickFix攻擊活動，濫用Google試算表作為C2管道
items.summary: 為了降低遭到偵測與阻擋的機率，駭客在攻擊活動中藉助合法雲端平臺服務作為C2管道的案例，近來逐漸增加，Cisco資安威脅研究團隊Talos近日揭露的一起ClickFix攻擊事件便是其中的典型。

items.title: Cisco修補Nexus 9000系列交換器重大遠端程式碼執行漏洞
items.summary: Cisco修補Nexus 9000系列交換器的重大漏洞CVE-2026-20212，影響搭載Silicon One ASIC的機型，以及這些機型對應的NX-OS 10.x版軟體，Cisco已發布修補版本，建議用戶使用Software Checker確認自身交換器所對應的NX-OS修補版本。

items.title: OpenAI籲美國制定強制AI安全規範，要求頂尖AI業者接受獨立評估
items.summary: 頂尖AI模型的自主操作能力持續提升，既有安全控管是否跟得上也成為產業焦點。OpenAI於9月9日呼籲美國建立聯邦層級的強制性AI安全規範，主要適用於開發頂尖AI系統、資源充足的少數業者，要求依模型能力與風險接受安全測試及獨立評估，並強化網路安全防護與重大事件通報。

items.title: 研究人員Nightmare Eclipse揭露Microsoft Defender零時差漏洞ShieldCrash
items.summary: 與微軟槓上的資安研究員Nightmare Eclipse（Chaotic Eclipse），從今年4月開始不斷揭露微軟產品的零時差漏洞，近期她將目標轉向其他廠牌的防毒軟體與EDR系統，以及Nvidia元件。

items.title: fix(memory): preserve search budgets around managed embedding readine…
items.summary: fix(memory): preserve search budgets around managed embedding readiness (#143590) Fixes #143169. Managed embedding cold starts could exceed the 15-second memory-search limit even while inside the configured readiness timeout. The search then aborted startup and lost semantic recall. This change pauses the corpus and query-embedding clocks only while the service owner waits for readiness. Each clock resumes with its remaining budget before router reconciliation or embedding HTTP work. Concurrent wiki searches keep a separate 15-second deadline. A wiki timeout preserves completed memory results and leaves memory retries available. Caller cancellation, shared service leases, readiness failure, and idle shutdown retain their existing owners. The repair also handles a query watchdog that subscribes during an existing pause and removes the corpus listener when work ends. No new configuration, database schema, persistence policy, or dependency is introduced. Validation uses an isolated built Gateway, the registered `memory_search` tool, real Memory Core SQLite storage, a synthetic loopback chat endpoint, and a managed child embedding service. The baseline aborts a 70-second cold start at the search deadline. The corrected candidate returns the known semantic hit after readiness; its warm retry works. Slow wiki results are excluded and fast wiki results are retained. Persistent public-client controls cover shared and solo cancellation, the configured readiness failure, and an embedding HTTP request that exceeds the remaining search budget. A separate registered-adapter control confirms that 100 ms reconciliation after a 70-second startup preserves recall, while 25-second reconciliation is aborted at about 15 seconds before any query embedding request. After the final CI correction, 120 focused memory tests passed, including the stalled-wiki result and retry regression. A rebuilt public flow preserved memory at the wiki timeout and completed the next memory search in 107 ms. Earlier provider, service, and deadline-control tests remain applicable to their unchanged owners. Original-code probes fail at the repaired boundaries. Formatting, ordinary lint, source ratchets, the native commit hook, and the runtime build passed. Full type checking and broader suites run in GitHub CI. The loopback fixtures use deterministic embeddings; they do not certify an external provider or arbitrary model quality. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.title: fix(sqlite): name the repair path in schema drift failures (#143531)
items.summary: fix(sqlite): name the repair path in schema drift failures (#143531) A drifted or missing canonical index aborts gateway startup, and the thrown text stated only the drift. Operators saw an unbootable gateway with no remediation, while the two sibling throws in the same agent-schema assertion already point at `openclaw doctor --fix`. Name that owner in the shared throw so both call sites inherit it. Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_014rTGeD4bUUEvA6vupgJt4d

items.title: fix(models): reuse prepared stores when discovery is skipped (#143695)
items.summary: fix(models): reuse prepared stores when discovery is skipped (#143695) Honor an explicitly supplied prepared runtime when filling missing auth or model stores. Skipping discovery must not discard captured model metadata and credentials. Explicit caller stores retain precedence, with caller auth forked into the prepared registry when needed. Cover literal model metadata and credentials for all four supplied-store combinations, and replace the reached empty-object test registry with the existing in-memory factory. Related: #130706, #142100
